claim_one_line: THE COUNTED INPUT LIST, AUDITED: ONE CONTINUOUS DIMENSIONLESS INPUT, NOT ZERO -- AND THE TWO FIVES ARE DIFFERENT FIVES. (1) THE DEFINED TERM: COMPUTE_THE_PROGRAM section 1 defines 'compute the entire program' as 'compute over the object as FULL RELATIONS, never as a single manifold' -- a QUANTIFIER INSTRUCTION with a standing inventory (member, ends, class, sisters, rows, child, faces, axioms, algebra, observer), where 'faces' is the eleven of B805/B806 plus the twelfth character-variety/trace-map substrate; so 'the object does not contain X by construct' is a claim at the widest quantifier the repo defines, and B803 makes the member/class gap structural (six of 25 pre-B800 closures inverted it). (2) THE TYPING, SEALED: B1015's DECLARATION reads 'the F2 bits and the Lie type are discrete; the scale slot is A1; the one continuous dimensionless input is A2'. So FOUR of the five counted inputs ARE dimensionless -- 'zero dimensionless inputs' is false as stated -- but all four are DISCRETE (B1017: the VEV direction is 'orbit-valued, not a continuous dimensionless parameter'), and the count of CONTINUOUS dimensionless inputs is EXACTLY ONE: A2 = c = 6*sigma, declared, sealed and PRICED as an anchor, not derived. L154 is the single open cell that would convert it to an output and take the count to zero. WHAT_WOULD_COUNT grades Tier 4 parameter-free NOT DONE and forbids any arc claiming 'parameter-free'; THE_CLAIM section 2 keeps 'zero FREE dimensionless parameters' as a SCORING rule, which is not a proof the anchor is unnecessary. (3) THE OWNER'S PRINCIPLE IS THE PROGRAMME'S OWN DOCTRINE AND IT PASSES ITS OWN FIRST QUANTITATIVE TEST -- B1000's sealed census (declared prior OUTCOME B, >4; 25 hits / 19 arcs; deduped by referent; classified before totalling) returns FIVE CLOSINGS across FOUR SECTORS with no fifth sector -- WITH THREE NAMED EXCEPTIONS graded ARTIFACT, 'ours, not the object's, reducible in principle': the 6d type (a class-S bridge choice), the filling slope (a Dehn route choice), P5 menu completeness (a method import). (4) THE DEFECT: THE_CLAIM section 1's five typed external data and B1000's five closings have the SAME CARDINALITY AND DIFFERENT MEMBERSHIP -- THE_CLAIM carries 'one Lie type (the 6d type J)', which B1000 grades an ARTIFACT, and carries NO space closing anywhere on the page, while B1000 counts the 4d lift / N=2->N=1 datum as a genuine closing in the space sector. AND THE AGREEMENT WAS ASSERTED IN BOTH PLACES: B1017 closes 'What does NOT change: B1000's five-closings census (confirmed)' while its own resource table spends the Lie type on the 6d type and assigns no resource to space at all, and THE_CLAIM repeats 'B1000's census of five closings stands'.
